title.zh: 约化 Hall 各向异性 Picard 平衡

summary: Iterate an axisymmetric flux through a caller-owned pressure closure, reduced Hall drift/current relation and dense Green update; reevaluate the terminal state and return bounded convergence and compatibility diagnostics.

identity.relation: caller-supplied pressure state and reduced Hall current to axisymmetric Green-feedback magnetic flux
identity.direction: R-Z grid, vacuum flux, dense Green response, pressure_closure and ion properties -> terminal flux, Hall state, field, pressure and diagnostics
identity.definition: Starting from a copy of psi_vac and zero prior cell currents, each outer step derives B from the current psi, checks the step field floor, calls pressure_closure(B,psi), validates and broadcasts the primary pressures, selects active cells, computes reduced-Hall J_phi and drifts, then applies a flux-relaxed Green update. The outer loop stops at relative_psi_change <= tol or maxiter. On the returned psi it repeats field, closure, pressure shape coercion, Hall and cell-current evaluation, then applies active-cell firehose and optional strict parallel-force/generalized-Ohm compatibility checks. The terminal path does not repeat the step field-floor or graph-level pressure nonnegativity gate; the Hall leaf still checks pressure finiteness and its optional ion-pressure state. The Hall Operator may run its own bounded local inertia iteration inside each evaluation.
identity.model: axisymmetric reduced Hall and gyrotropic-pressure Picard feedback with caller-bound closure
identity.geometry: rectilinear cylindrical R-Z mesh, at least three nodes on each axis
identity.coordinates: arrays indexed [Z,R]; dense Green response follows the bound Picard update's C-order cell-current convention
identity.boundary: The field Operator applies its axis and one-sided grid-derivative rules. The graph performs no free-boundary reconstruction; vacuum flux and Green response are caller supplied.
assumptions: The caller pressure_closure(B,psi) interprets psi=R A_phi in Wb/rad and supplies a physically compatible state, including ion_density, electron_pressure and electrostatic_potential needed by the Hall leaf.
The dense Green matrix maps cell currents in A to psi=R A_phi in Wb/rad on the same grid; no 2*pi conversion occurs inside the graph.
A pressure closure, mask callable and control values must remain meaningful on each iterated and terminal state; this graph does not independently certify their physical model.

Default composite-trapezoid weights integrate exactly over the supplied node-domain rectangle; boundary nodes have half-interval weights. Explicit cell_edges=(radial_edges,axial_edges), each with center_count+1 monotone finite entries enclosing its centers, instead define cell-center areas. No 2*pi*R factor multiplies toroidal filament current.

inputs.name: r_grid
inputs.description: Cylindrical radius mesh.
inputs.constraints: Same two-dimensional rectilinear shape as z_grid and psi_vac; strictly increasing radial axis, at least three columns. The bound field/Hall leaves additionally require nonnegative R.

inputs.name: z_grid
inputs.description: Axial coordinate mesh.
inputs.constraints: Strictly increasing rectilinear axial axis, at least three rows; same shape as r_grid and psi_vac.

inputs.name: psi_vac
inputs.description: Vacuum psi=R A_phi and initial evolving state.
inputs.constraints: Same shape as the grid; copied before iteration. Full linked flux requires an explicit 2*pi conversion outside this graph.

inputs.name: g_psi
inputs.description: Dense cell-current-to-psi Green response.
inputs.constraints: Finite exact square shape, with the Picard leaf's C-order grid mapping and no embedded 2*pi or cell-area factor.

inputs.name: pressure_closure
inputs.description: Caller-owned callable returning pressure and Hall species state for each B and psi=R A_phi.
inputs.units: output pressure Pa; input B T and psi Wb/rad
inputs.constraints: Must interpret psi in Wb/rad and return p_parallel and p_perpendicular, scalar or exact-grid nonnegative finite Pa values, plus required Hall leaf keys ion_density (m^-3), electron_pressure (Pa) and electrostatic_potential (V); optional species pressures follow the Hall leaf contract.

inputs.name: ion_mass_kg
inputs.description: Positive ion mass passed to the Hall leaf.
inputs.constraints: Strictly positive in the bound Hall leaf.

inputs.name: ion_charge_c
inputs.description: Positive ion charge magnitude passed to the Hall leaf.
inputs.constraints: Strictly positive in the bound Hall leaf.

inputs.name: tol
inputs.description: Outer relative flux-change stopping threshold.
inputs.constraints: The graph checks finiteness but not positivity; choose a positive value for the intended stopping criterion.

inputs.name: maxiter
inputs.description: Maximum outer Picard updates.
inputs.constraints: Integer >= 1; no automatic retry beyond this bound.

inputs.name: relax
inputs.description: Previous-flux retention weight in the Green step.
inputs.constraints: 0 <= value < 1; applied to flux, not raw cell currents.

inputs.name: minimum_field
inputs.description: Minimum acceptable poloidal field magnitude during outer updates.
inputs.constraints: Strictly positive; each iteration checks B before invoking the pressure closure. The terminal reevaluation does not repeat this gate.

inputs.name: minimum_firehose_margin
inputs.description: Terminal active-cell firehose/tension threshold.
inputs.constraints: If nonnegative, terminal active cells with margin <= this threshold cause FloatingPointError; a negative value disables this check.

inputs.name: plasma_mask
inputs.description: Fixed active cells or caller policy evaluated at each B,psi.
inputs.dtype: boolean array-like, Python callable or None
inputs.constraints: Null selects all cells; fixed/callable masks must match the grid shape. Hall drift further excludes axis, low-density and unresolved-field cells.

inputs.name: hall_multiplier
inputs.description: Multiplier passed to the reduced Hall leaf.
inputs.constraints: Nonnegative.

inputs.name: include_toroidal_inertia
inputs.description: Enable the Hall leaf's local toroidal-inertia correction.
inputs.constraints: Actual boolean scalar, not numeric 0/1.

inputs.name: hall_density_floor_fraction
inputs.description: Peak active-density fraction defining Hall drift support.
inputs.constraints: 0 <= value < 1.

inputs.name: maximum_inertial_mach
inputs.description: Local ion-drift Mach cap.
inputs.constraints: Strictly positive.

inputs.name: inertia_relax
inputs.description: Previous-current weight inside the Hall leaf's local iteration.
inputs.constraints: 0 <= value < 1.

inputs.name: inertia_tolerance
inputs.description: Local inertia current-change tolerance.
inputs.constraints: Strictly positive.

inputs.name: inertia_max_iterations
inputs.description: Local inertia iteration bound per Hall call.
inputs.constraints: Integer >= 1; local nonconvergence raises rather than returning the outer graph state.

inputs.name: compatibility_tol
inputs.description: Terminal parallel-momentum error threshold.
inputs.constraints: Nonnegative; exceedance adds a message and raises only if strict_compatibility is true.

inputs.name: ohm_tolerance
inputs.description: Terminal normalized generalized-Ohm error threshold.
inputs.constraints: Strictly positive; exceedance adds a message and raises only if strict_compatibility is true.

inputs.name: strict_compatibility
inputs.description: Reject terminal compatibility exceedance instead of returning messages.
inputs.constraints: Actual boolean scalar, not numeric 0/1; does not disable the separate firehose check.

inputs.name: cell_edges
inputs.description: Default composite-trapezoid weights integrate exactly over the supplied node-domain rectangle; boundary nodes have half-interval weights. Explicit cell_edges=(radial_edges,axial_edges), each with center_count+1 monotone finite entries enclosing its centers, instead define cell-center areas. No 2*pi*R factor multiplies toroidal filament current.
inputs.dtype: pair of finite arrays or None
inputs.constraints: Default composite-trapezoid weights integrate exactly over the supplied node-domain rectangle; boundary nodes have half-interval weights. Explicit cell_edges=(radial_edges,axial_edges), each with center_count+1 monotone finite entries enclosing its centers, instead define cell-center areas. No 2*pi*R factor multiplies toroidal filament current.

outputs.name: psi
outputs.description: Last psi=R A_phi state after one or more bounded Picard updates.
outputs.constraints: Terminal field, closure and Hall state are recomputed at this psi.

outputs.name: plasma_cell_currents
outputs.description: Terminal or step current density integrated with the explicitly declared node/cell-domain weights.
outputs.constraints: Default composite-trapezoid weights integrate exactly over the supplied node-domain rectangle; boundary nodes have half-interval weights. Explicit cell_edges=(radial_edges,axial_edges), each with center_count+1 monotone finite entries enclosing its centers, instead define cell-center areas. No 2*pi*R factor multiplies toroidal filament current.

outputs.name: J_phi
outputs.description: Terminal reduced-Hall toroidal current density.
outputs.constraints: Hall leaf zeros cells outside plasma_mask.

outputs.name: B_R
outputs.description: Terminal radial poloidal magnetic field.
outputs.constraints: Derived from returned psi.

outputs.name: B_Z
outputs.description: Terminal axial poloidal magnetic field.
outputs.constraints: Derived from returned psi.

outputs.name: B
outputs.description: Terminal poloidal-field magnitude.
outputs.constraints: Terminal recomputation does not independently check minimum_field.

outputs.name: p_parallel
outputs.description: Terminal caller-closure parallel pressure after scalar broadcast.
outputs.constraints: Grid-shaped and checked finite by the Hall leaf; the graph-level nonnegative pressure gate is not repeated at terminal evaluation.

outputs.name: p_perpendicular
outputs.description: Terminal caller-closure perpendicular pressure after scalar broadcast.
outputs.constraints: Grid-shaped and checked finite by the Hall leaf; the graph-level nonnegative pressure gate is not repeated at terminal evaluation.

outputs.name: parallel_force
outputs.description: Terminal Hall target force projected along the field.
outputs.constraints: Diagnostic from hall_state.

outputs.name: force_R
outputs.description: Terminal radial target force including any centrifugal correction.
outputs.constraints: From hall_state, not necessarily the uncorrected pressure force.

outputs.name: force_Z
outputs.description: Terminal axial target force.
outputs.constraints: From hall_state.

outputs.name: ion_toroidal_velocity
outputs.description: Terminal Hall ion toroidal drift.
outputs.constraints: Zero outside Hall-active cells.

outputs.name: electron_toroidal_velocity
outputs.description: Terminal Hall electron toroidal drift.
outputs.constraints: Zero outside Hall-active cells.

outputs.name: electric_field_R
outputs.description: Terminal radial electrostatic field from the Hall leaf.
outputs.constraints: Negative radial gradient of caller potential.

outputs.name: electric_field_Z
outputs.description: Terminal axial electrostatic field from the Hall leaf.
outputs.constraints: Negative axial gradient of caller potential.

outputs.name: hall_state
outputs.description: Complete terminal reduced-Hall Operator result including local masks and diagnostics.
outputs.constraints: Not a separate published asset; follows the bound Hall leaf's output contract.

outputs.name: converged
outputs.description: True only when the terminal unrelaxed fixed-point residual passes tol (and free-boundary force compatibility passes).
outputs.constraints: Relaxed stagnation alone does not establish convergence.

outputs.name: iterations
outputs.description: Executed outer Picard update count.
outputs.constraints: Between one and maxiter inclusive.

outputs.name: relative_psi_change
outputs.description: Last outer update's relative flux change.
outputs.constraints: Uses the bound Picard leaf's norm convention.

outputs.name: parallel_force_error
outputs.description: Terminal Hall parallel-force error fraction.
outputs.constraints: Compared to compatibility_tol for optional strict rejection.

outputs.name: generalized_ohm_error
outputs.description: Terminal normalized generalized-Ohm residual.
outputs.constraints: Compared to ohm_tolerance for optional strict rejection.

outputs.name: closure_state
outputs.description: Unmodified mapping returned by the terminal caller closure.
outputs.constraints: Primary scalar pressures may remain scalar here even though p_parallel and p_perpendicular output fields were broadcast.

outputs.name: firehose_margin
outputs.description: Terminal Hall firehose/tension margin.
outputs.constraints: Checked on terminal active cells only when minimum_firehose_margin >= 0.

outputs.name: compatibility_messages
outputs.description: Messages for parallel-momentum or generalized-Ohm threshold exceedance.
outputs.constraints: Can be nonempty on a successful result only when strict_compatibility is false.

outputs.name: iteration_history
outputs.description: Per-update flux/current changes and generalized-Ohm error.
outputs.constraints: Each item has iteration, relative_psi_change, relative_current_change and generalized_ohm_error.

outputs.name: fixed_point_residual
outputs.description: Unrelaxed flux-map residual recomputed at the returned terminal closure/current state; convergence requires <=tol.
outputs.constraints: Unrelaxed flux-map residual recomputed at the returned terminal closure/current state; convergence requires <=tol.

preconditions: A compatible caller pressure_closure supplies both primary pressures and Hall species-state fields at each iterated and terminal field.
The caller Green response matches the grid and cell-current convention of the Picard leaf.
Iteration and returned terminal fields must remain at or above minimum_field; the numerical threshold does not by itself establish physical validity of the field or Hall diagnostics.
supported: Bounded axisymmetric reduced-Hall magnetic feedback with selected gyrotropic pressure and an explicit caller-controlled closure and mask policy.
After terminal field, pressure closure, Hall drift and flux-map reevaluation, reject a terminal field below minimum_field before returning; earlier callback or dependency failures still propagate.
excluded: A built-in kinetic pressure model, density evolution, free-boundary response or non-axisymmetric equilibrium.
A guarantee of outer convergence, local inertia convergence, compatibility or physical correctness for arbitrary caller closures.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError/TypeError for missing ports, malformed/nonfinite grid or Green response, noncallable closure, invalid controls, wrong-shaped mask or bad iteration pressure/state; bound leaf and callback exceptions propagate. The terminal path coerces pressure shape without repeating the graph-level nonnegative check, but the Hall leaf still rejects nonfinite primary pressure and invalid optional ion pressure. The graph's own grid check does not reject negative R, but the bound field/Hall leaves do.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: An iteration field below minimum_field raises FloatingPointError before its closure call. Terminal active firehose margin at/below a nonnegative minimum_firehose_margin raises FloatingPointError. Strict terminal parallel-force or generalized-Ohm threshold exceedance raises ValueError. A Hall local inertia nonconvergence raises RuntimeError; other callback/dependency failures propagate. The terminal field is also checked against minimum_field.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: At maxiter without meeting the outer flux threshold, reevaluate and gate the terminal state, then return converged=false with last psi and history. Local Hall inertia nonconvergence instead raises RuntimeError.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No mapping is returned after an exception. Outer bounded nonconvergence is a complete last-state mapping if terminal evaluation and gates succeed.

example.description: A uniform axial vacuum field, constant isotropic species state and zero Green response converge in one outer update.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.equilibrium import solve_reduced_hall_anisotropic_picard
r_grid, z_grid = np.meshgrid(np.linspace(0.0, 0.4, 5), np.linspace(-0.2, 0.2, 5))
psi_vac = r_grid**2
def pressure_closure(_b, psi):
    zeros = np.zeros_like(psi)
    return {'p_parallel': 0.0, 'p_perpendicular': 0.0, 'ion_density': np.full_like(psi, 1e18), 'electron_pressure': zeros, 'electrostatic_potential': zeros}
result = solve_reduced_hall_anisotropic_picard(r_grid=r_grid, z_grid=z_grid, psi_vac=psi_vac, g_psi=np.zeros((25,25)), ion_mass_kg=1.67262192595e-27, ion_charge_c=1.602176634e-19, pressure_closure=pressure_closure, maxiter=2)
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['psi'], psi_vac)
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['J_phi'], 0.0)
assert result['converged'] and result['iterations'] == 1
example.expected: Unchanged vacuum flux, zero terminal Hall current and one converged outer update.

scope: Hall-disabled isotropic current and vacuum-flux regression.

A Hall-disabled manufactured graph input joins a circular-filament vacuum psi, mirror-plasma Green matrix and one active current cell; it checks the nonzero flux increment against direct filament response and the returned off-source field against direct filament fields.
Nonzero Green response and previous-state feedback over a bounded two-step run.
Scalar-pressure broadcast, wrong-shape rejection, nonfinite/invalid controls and disabled firehose threshold.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Manufactured and analytic discrete checks establish only the stated poloidal model and declared integration geometry. Arbitrary Green matrices, pressure closures, experimental plasma applicability and public release are not established by these tests.
known_limitations: Caller-supplied physical closures and Green responses require their own evidence and coherent psi=R A_phi (Wb/rad) normalization.
Floating-point rounding envelopes do not bound discretization error or experimental uncertainty.
No expert scientific endorsement or public release follows from this numerical successor.

nodes.description: Copy vacuum flux, initialize previous raw cell currents, count outer updates and retain bounded flux feedback.
Derive B_R, B_Z and |B| from each current or terminal flux state.
Reject a sub-minimum field before each iteration closure; terminal reevaluation bypasses this comparison.
Call the caller-owned pressure_closure(B,psi) on each step and terminal state.

Broadcast scalar pressures or require exact-grid pressure shapes and evaluate fixed/dynamic active mask; graph-level finite/nonnegative primary pressure checks occur during iterations, while the terminal Hall leaf still checks finiteness.
Compute reduced-Hall current, local optional inertia and diagnostics on the active domain.
Apply dense Green response and flux relaxation during each update and recompute terminal raw cell currents.
Use terminal reevaluation of field, closure, Hall and raw currents; apply active firehose and optional strict compatibility checks, then expose the exact returned mapping.

execution.ordering: Validate geometry and controls; per step derive field, reject sub-minimum B, invoke/normalize caller closure, select active cells, compute reduced-Hall state, apply Green flux update and record diagnostics. After stopping, derive field, invoke closure, compute Hall state and raw cell currents again, then check active firehose and optional strict compatibility. A terminal minimum-field comparison is also required. Terminal reevaluation computes the unrelaxed flux-map residual on the returned field/closure state; it determines converged independently of a small relaxed step.
branches: plasma_mask is a fixed grid, callable(B,psi), or all-active default.
A negative minimum_firehose_margin disables its terminal gate.
At maxiter without flux convergence, return converged=false if terminal evaluation succeeds.
strict_compatibility=false returns compatibility_messages instead of raising for parallel-force/Ohm threshold exceedance.
execution.state_ownership: The graph owns a copy of evolving psi, previous raw cell currents, outer count and history. The Hall leaf owns each bounded local inertia fixed point. The caller owns pressure_closure, Green response, original inputs and optional mask policy.
execution.failure_propagation: Invalid graph, callback or leaf inputs abort. Iteration field floor, terminal firehose, optional strict compatibility and Hall local nonconvergence follow their documented exception paths; outer nonconvergence alone returns last state.

feedback.state: psi, previous raw cell currents, last relative flux/current changes, last generalized-Ohm error, iteration count and history
feedback.initialization: psi is a copy of psi_vac, previous currents are zeros, relative flux change is infinite, count is zero and history is empty.
feedback.update_order: For current psi compute field, pressure closure and Hall current; use the Green leaf to form psi_next and raw cell currents; append diagnostics and replace psi/prior currents, then compare unrelaxed fixed_point_residual with tol.
feedback.continue_when: Unrelaxed step fixed_point_residual > tol and executed count < maxiter.
feedback.stop_when: Unrelaxed step fixed_point_residual <= tol or maxiter reached; terminal reevaluation independently determines the returned convergence flag.
feedback.iteration_bound: Validated runtime integer maxiter >= 1; each Hall evaluation also has inertia_max_iterations >= 1
feedback.nonconvergence: Return the reevaluated last outer state with converged=false if terminal checks succeed. A nonconverged Hall local inertia iteration raises RuntimeError instead.
